projectTitle: Sparx Hockey: A Shopify store for a skate sharpener
project_haiku: Sparx sells an at-home skate sharpener to players, rinks, and pro shops. With Magnifico Design, we built the Shopify store for the machine, the rings, the parts, and the instructions.
project_footer_CTA: Selling a product people also have to learn how to use? Sparx is a store and a manual in one site.
pageSummary:
The job

Sparx Hockey, in Acton, Massachusetts, makes an automated skate sharpener for hockey, figure skating, and sled hockey. Buyers are families, teams, rinks, and shops. The site had to sell the machine and explain the grinding rings, the service plan, and the edge sensor that goes with it. The company is the NHL's preferred at-home sharpener. Magnifico Design led the design. Knectar built the store.

What we built

The site is Shopify. Navigation covers sharpeners, grinding rings, accessories, bundles, service plans, parts, and the Sparx BEAM edge monitor. Bundles pair a sharpener with rings. Product and help content sit on the same site, so a buyer can read how a ring works before adding it.

Outcomes

A player can buy the sharpener and the right ring. A rink can find parts and a service plan. Sparx can merchandise a bundle without a separate campaign site.
